title: Amazingly Aromatic American Chicken Skewers
description: A jammy and pillowy American dish featuring chicken drumsticks, this recipe is a show-off macrobiotic-friendly meal, served in a terracotta dish. The chicken is shaped like nigiri for a unique presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and arrange the chicken drumsticks on it, leaving some space between each piece.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the terracotta dish by brushing it with a little bit of olive oil.
After the chicken has baked for 30 minutes, remove it from the oven and increase the oven temperature to broil.
Thread each chicken drumstick onto a skewer, shaping it like nigiri, and place the skewers in the prepared terracotta dish.
Broil the chicken skewers in the oven for an additional 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove the chicken from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, directly from the terracotta dish.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
